message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of a closed-loop memory workflow for an agent learning from successive tasks.","description":"A timeline of tasks shows an agent interacting with an environment and retrieving relevant items from ReasoningBank. Past experience trajectories are evaluated by an LLM-as-a-Judge, producing success insights or failure reflections that are extracted into memory items and consolidated into the bank. At a later task, a memory extractor uses a stored item—with a title, description, and content—alongside a prior experience trajectory to guide the agent’s response.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
